Test build. Install into a fresh arm64ec container.

GE-Proton 11.0-5 arm64ec (bionic) from [The412Banner](https://github.com/The412Banner/proton-wine), plus userspace ntsync from [GameNative](https://github.com/GameNative/ntsync-android).

## Turn esync off

**esync and ntsync cannot both be on.** Winlator enables esync by default, and with it on the container hangs on loading and comes up to a black desktop. Turn esync off in the container settings before you start.

If you would rather keep esync, set `PROTON_NO_NTSYNC=1` instead — that disables ntsync and leaves esync working.

## Environment variables

- `PROTON_NO_NTSYNC=1` — disable ntsync
- `PROTON_NO_KERNEL_NTSYNC=1` — force the userspace backend even when `/dev/ntsync` exists

## Files

- `GE-proton-11.0-5-ntsync-arm64ec-sdk28.wcp` — GameNative / Bannerlator / WinNative
- `GE-proton-wine-11.0-5-ntsync-arm64ec-sdk28.wcp.xz` — Winlator CMOD & Ludashi

`versionName` is `11.0-9-arm64ec`, so this installs alongside the original The412Banner build instead of replacing it.
